about: PROVISIONAL REALIZATIONS: his provisional realization choices for one Learning Goal's activity, held as contract-shaped contributions so the engine builds them exactly as it builds any other knowledge, while every item stays marked as his choice for that activity and never as canonical knowledge. Added 15 October 2026 (stage K2) for his reply filed 17 October 2026: 'The priority remains producing one complete, representative Play Out from the Back activity through the normal generation pathway, without introducing unnecessary architecture or treating this first realization as the canonical version of the Learning Goal.' and, of the post-regain area, 'I also agree that the post-regain area is a provisional realization choice, not canonical Goalkeeper Build-Out knowledge.' HOW IT IS READ (back/src/system/derivation/corpus.ts, loadProvisionalRealizations): a realization joins a derivation ONLY where the selected goal's authorization record names it (learning-goal-authorizations.json, provisionalRealization); nothing selects it otherwise, and no goal is named in code. It is never written into contracts.json, never keyed to the context it realizes, and never applied as a restatement. Its shape is the Sport Profile's precedent (SD-17: a source outside the representation enters as items under its own contract), with three differences the loader enforces and refuses the whole file on: every item has basis OWNER_RULING, quotes him (words, citedAs) and carries category PROVISIONAL_REALIZATION_CHOICE, which reaches every support entry and the rendering fixture; a realization holds NO declaration (a provisional choice says what this activity does, never what knowledge does not constrain, so no qualified or unqualified non-claim can enter through this file, and his M6 disjointness proof is never needed here); and an item may not name a designation refused below. realizationChoices names the realization-choices file whose entries REPLACE the game form's for the lines they list, each replacement declared (supplied-realization.ts). notWithPracticeSituations lists the practice situations the realization was not designed for: that combination is refused, not built. ADDED 26 October 2026 (Stage F): A01-R2, the goal version, a VARIANT of A01-R1 (basedOn, withdraws, its own items; composed once at load, corpus.ts), recording his replies filed 25 and 26 October 2026 in his words; A01's record lists it before A01-R1, waiting on two decisions of his (goal suitability; the penalty area), so it is never tried until he makes them. ADDED 23 October 2026 (H2, the d26 design's build step 2, for his reply filed 26 October 2026, item 10: 'The normal Laws of the Game should apply by default wherever they are applicable, unless an activity introduces an explicit, knowledge-authorized modification.'): an item may record its departures from the sport's normal laws (departsFrom: the law, why, his words, the whole of it or a named part, and optionally the precondition whose absence it rests on), and a realization declares how strictly its activity is held to the default-laws account (defaultLawsCheck: ENFORCE or REPORT, why, his words; a variant inherits its base's unless it states its own). Both are validated against the Sport Profile's defaultLaws block and read only by that account (corpus.ts; realization/default-laws-check.ts); no value of any item changes. A01-R2 now waits on a third decision of his as well (D-DEFAULT-LAWS: the adaptations its account names as owed).

The building team keeps A01-R1's target, scoring event and build-out conditions (his item 1: "Building team: Controlled progression beyond the marked line during an active goalkeeper-initiated build-out."). WHAT IT DOES NOT HOLD: the 5 m area and its regain score (withdrawn, his item 12); a penalty area, a handling region or a handling rule (D-PENALTY-AREA open; his item 7 refuses "an undefined area that the coach simply points out" and "a feet-only goalkeeper restriction as the default for this realization", so neither is written); a suitability for its goal (D-GOAL-SUITABILITY open); any law needing an explicit adaptation in this small-sided environment (his item 10: "The offside question, for example, may need an explicit ruling for this small-sided environment, but we should not expand the current work into a comprehensive reconstruction of soccer's laws." - not filled); a positional rule for the goalkeeper (his item 6: "I don't want to prescribe goalkeeper movement solutions through a special positioning rule."). OWN GOALS (his item 10, "I agree that an own goal against the building team counts for the pressing team in the goal-based realization."; item 11, "Own goals: Apply the normal soccer rule.") need no item: a score is the ball entering the goal the pressing team's objective references, whoever touched it last (OUR READING, recorded on the scoring relationship). SHOTS GOING OUT (his item 11, "Shots going out: The coach may conclude the episode and restart the goalkeeper's build-out under the already authorized activity structure. We do not need an additional scoring mechanism.") are carried by A01-R1's kept items (the coach-judged conclusion A01-R1-T1-3 and the end-line restarts A01-R1-T1-6, T1-7, T4-3, T5-3); nothing is added. RESTATED 24 October 2026 (R1): his reply filed 27 October 2026, item 4 ("I want the same restart principle for both the physical-goal and target-zone versions." "Whenever the ball becomes dead, play resets to a new goalkeeper-initiated build-out." "There should be no separate corners, goal kicks, throw-ins, free kicks, or penalty kicks for this activity."), so a shot over the goal line, and every other ball over it, takes the common restart this version inherits from A01-R1 (A01-R1-RP1-1, the out-of-play elements A01-R1-T1-8 and T1-9 and the widened restart items); the end-line restarts named above are withdrawn from A01-R1, and this version's own restart bound (A01-R2-T4-5) is widened to every dead ball and bound, in his item 6 words, to the building team's side of the marked line. A DEPARTURE, REPORTED: the pressing team's objective reference is written by the end designation (team=TEAM_AT_AXIS_END, the end the pressing role holds in both blocks under the end exchange) and not by the role, because an objective is individuated by its setup designation and a role-keyed reference does not attach (the design of 25 October 2026, Stage B; measured TEST-ONLY then). That departs from our own application of his D7 sentence in refusedDesignations ("it narrows what this file may say"); the designation is not one the file refuses, and GA-ROLE-EVENTS clause 4 refuses the version if the pressing role ever stood at the other end (the ends kept).
